symptom: Factory layered UI showed Chief Engineer blueprint coverage 0/3 and no handoff evidence while the same run was already executing Director and showing physical Go file activity.
root_cause: useFactory fetched the artifacts endpoint when the run id first became current and again only at terminal settlement. Stage artifacts are appended after each stage settles, so a running UI retained the early empty snapshot through chief_engineer_review and director_dispatch.

fix.behavior: Refresh canonical Factory run artifacts whenever runtime.v2 delivers stage_completed for the current run. Existing in-flight coalescing prevents overlapping artifact requests.

residual_risk: A live browser refresh on a subsequent staged Factory run is still required to close the UI projection defect. This defect is independent of r33 terminal Director failure and r43 execution result.
